# RadioGroup

RadioGroup — one question and its radio answers. A `Fieldset` (legend plus grouped fields) holding one real Base UI `RadioGroup`, which carries the `role="radiogroup"`, the keyboard roving tabindex across options, and `aria-required`/`aria-readonly`; the Fieldset stays plain grouping and the legend, which the group inherits as its own accessible name. Lays them out stacked or inline, can put scale ends either side (`leadingText`, `trailingText` — see the "Linear scale" story), and shows one error for the group. `isDisabled` on the group overrides every `Radio`'s own. The value is the chosen option's value, or `null`/`undefined` while unanswered — a radio group does not fall back to its first option, so a response of `1` can be told apart from no response.

Also asked as: single choice, radio buttons, single select, multiple choice, radio list.

**Import:** `import { RadioGroup } from '@/components';`

## Usage

Use a radio group for one question with mutually exclusive answers, visible all at once: a handful of options someone picks by scanning, not searching. For a long list of options, use Select. For independent choices rather than one answer among several, use a group of Checkbox.

The group owns the legend, the value and the error, so each option stays a plain radio.

## Best practices

### Name the question with a group label. {#name-the-question-with-a-group-label}

The `legend` tells people what the options answer. A group with no visible
legend needs its own `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`; the caller's wins over
the legend.

Do: The group has a visible question.
Don't: Options with no visible question.

### Stack three or more answers. {#stack-three-or-more-answers}

A stacked list scans faster than a row once options multiply. Keep `inline`
for short labels or a scale.

Do: A stacked list for several options.
Don't: A long row of options.

### Explain an error under the group. {#explain-an-error-under-the-group}

One message under the group says what went wrong and what to do; a bare error
state does not. Don't disable the group to block an answer instead: that hides
why and removes it from the tab order.

Do: The error is explained in one message.
Don't: The error state with no explanation.

### Leave the group unanswered until the person answers. {#leave-the-group-unanswered-until-the-person-answers}

`value` tells "answered zero" apart from "answered the first option." An unanswered group is `null` or `undefined` and never falls back to the first option. Check for that explicitly before treating the group as answered.

```jsx
<RadioGroup
    legend="How was the session?"
    leadingText="Not at all"
    trailingText="Very"
    options={['1', '2', '3', '4', '5']}
    value={rating}
    onChange={setRating}
/>
```

### Use `reveal` instead of a separate conditional field. {#use-reveal-instead-of-a-separate-conditional-field}

When choosing one option should show an extra field, such as "Other, please specify", pass that field as the option's `reveal` rather than rendering it outside the group. It stays scoped to the option that triggers it and disappears when another option is chosen.

## Accessibility

- **One real `radiogroup`, named by the legend.** The outer Fieldset supplies the `<fieldset>`/`<legend>` pair; the inner group repeats the legend's id as its own `aria-labelledby`, so assistive technology announces the question once, not twice.
- **Roving tabindex.** Tab enters and leaves the group as a single stop; arrow keys move the checked state between options, matching native radio button behavior.
- **A caller's own `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` wins over the legend**, for the rare case where the question is named another way.
- **One error, announced once.** `error` renders a single message tied to the group via `aria-describedby`, rather than repeating it per option.

## Parts

1. **Legend.** The question. It names the group and carries the required marker.
2. **Options.** Radios in a stacked or inline set. Each has a label and an optional description.
3. **Scale ends.** Optional `leadingText` and `trailingText` either side of the options.
4. **Reveal.** Optional content under an option, shown only while that option is chosen.
5. **Error.** One message under the group, tied to it with `aria-describedby`.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Hovered | As Radio. Unselected: `--ds-background-input-hovered` with a `--ds-border-brand` edge. Selected: the hovered step of the selected bold fill. |
| Selected | As Radio: `--ds-background-selected-bold` fill and `--ds-border-selected` edge. |
| Pressed | No step of its own. The hovered look holds while the pointer is down. |
| Focused | A 2px ring in `--ds-border-focused` on the one tab stop. |
| Invalid | Every unselected option takes `--ds-border-danger`, with one message for the group. |
| Read-only | Full contrast, focusable, `aria-readonly` on the group; the answer does not change. |
| Disabled | Every option takes the disabled fill and edge and leaves the tab order. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Options gap | Stacked `--stack-md`; inline column gap `--space-0625`. |
| Radio size | `--radio-control-size`, or `--radio-control-size-10` and `-14` through `size`. |
| Scale ends | `--ds-text`, body default; gap `--space-0625`. |
| Reveal indent | The radio width plus `--stack-md`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Write the legend as the question: "Did the session happen?" | A label for the field: "Session status". |
| Keep option labels short, parallel and in sentence case. | Mix one word with a full clause, or end labels with periods. |
| Order options from most to least likely, or from least to most risk. | Alphabetical order. |
| Label the ends of a scale: "Not at all" and "Very". | Leave a 1 to 5 scale unlabeled. |
| Say what to do in the error: "Choose an answer." | "Required" or "Invalid". |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | Base for every id in the group. Generated when omitted. |
| `name` | string | — | The form key the choices submit under. Defaults to the group's id. |
| `legend` | node | — | The question. Names the group. |
| `orientation` | enum | `'stacked'` | `stacked` (default) puts one option per line; `inline` lays them in a row, for short labels or a scale. |
| `options` | arrayOf (required) | `[]` | The answers. A string is its own value and label. An object can add a `description` under the label, `isDisabled`, an `id`, and `reveal`: content shown under the option while it is chosen. |
| `value` | optionValueType | — | The answer: one option value, or `null`/`undefined` while unanswered. |
| `defaultValue` | optionValueType | — | The option value chosen at the start, when the group is uncontrolled. Leave it out for no answer. |
| `onChange` | func | — | Receives the next answer's value. |
| `leadingText` | node | — | Scale end before the options, e.g. "Not at all". Describes the group. |
| `trailingText` | node | — | Scale end after the options, e.g. "Very". Describes the group. |
| `appearance` | enum | `'plain'` | Passed to every Radio. `card` draws each as a bordered tile. |
| `size` | enum | — | Radio control (dot) width, in px; unset keeps today's rendering. |
| `isRequired` | bool | `false` | The group needs an answer. Marked on the legend. |
| `isDisabled` | bool | `false` | Overrides every Radio's own `isDisabled`. |
| `isReadOnly` | bool | `false` | Shown and focusable, not changeable. |
| `isInvalid` | bool | — | Marks every Radio as failing validation. Defaults to whether `error` is set. |
| `error` | node | — | One error for the group, announced when it appears. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class names added to the fieldset beside the component's own. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline styles for the fieldset. |

## Variants
